title: Chapter 469
paragraphs: Chapter 469
Episode 132: Massacre and Strange...(3)
"Cough!"
Sandra bent over, coughing up blood. The Brada Mante had completely penetrated her collarbone and protruded out the other side.
It should have been the end for a human. Unless they had healing abilities like
those of King Rani or used Numereus's heritage, it was an irreparable fatal injury.
However, Jin felt some kind of intangible force pushing the blade that had pierced Sandra's collarbone.
It obviously wasn't aura.
Nor was it magical power.
'It's like...'
Divine power.
It was giving off a very similar feeling to the divine power Jin knew.
The power often displayed by the Silver Dragon Quicantel of Olta: the divine power of time.
'As I thought, I wasn't mistaken at first. But why is Sandra using the divine power of time?'
Sandra couldn't be Olta's contractor. Enya had already been under contract for a long time. Zifel hadn't managed to kill Enya and steal the contract as they had in Jin's previous life.
Divine powers can often be used by those who aren't contractors if they receive the blessing of the corresponding god, are granted the right to serve, or through other methods.
However, in such cases, only 'low-level divine powers' could be used.
Swoosh!
Jin swung his pushed-back blade again, slashing at Sandra's neck.

However, the Brada Mante couldn't touch her neck. The space around Sandra distorted strangely. When he swung his sword into it, only ripples occurred as if cutting water, and no damage could be inflicted.
'It's just like when I first met Quicantel. Back then, Quicantel neutralized my attacks in the same way.'
A divine power that quickly rewinds time to heal fatal wounds and secures safety while regeneration occurs.
That couldn't have been a low-level divine power.
Crick, Crick, Tick!
The sound of cogwheels meshing rapidly grew louder. The noise that occurred when using divine power was the only difference between Quicantel and Sandra.
Murakan also recognized Sandra's divine power. He blinked his eyes as if he had received quite a shock.
Vugo and the Runkandel knights were barely suppressing their astonishment as well.

'Variables that weren't included in the mission information keep appearing. It seems that Sandra Zifel's ability is part of the bio-golem experiment, but does it mean that a pure-blooded Zifel became an experimental subject? And she's Kelriak's daughter!'
As the sixth generation of Runkandel, Vugo had some knowledge about Zifel's bio-golem experiments.

As far as he knew, Zifel had never used pure-bloods for their bio-golem experiments until now. They had only used fanatical followers, ordinary people, or mages from lower-ranked families as experimental subjects.
"Does this mean they achieved stable results by experimenting with purebloods? Or is there another reason?"
Regardless, this was a discovery. Although they couldn't secure Amela, at least there was something peculiar to write in the report for Rosa.
Thanks to Sandra showing off her special power, Vugo carefully observed Jin and Murakan. He felt that if he stayed on the path longer, he might be able to gather more reportable incidents.
"Sigh, I've been hurt several times today. I hate pain, you know. I admit, I'm a bit lacking for a fight."
Sandra straightened her clothes and shrugged her shoulders.
"You have quite an unpleasant ability, Sandra Zipel."
"You, you look much better than on the advertisement board of the Goldfish Trading Company, don't you? I think dating would suit you better than fighting."
"Wouldn't it be better to activate the staff of the Magic Carpet Shop now?"
"Shall we go eat? Or tea?"
Was it because she was confident enough not to be tense even when discussing themselves, or was she just a person with many communication and conversation issues?
'Even when I met her briefly in my previous life, she only talked about what she wanted.'
Jin found it difficult to quickly grasp Sandra Zipel.
"Kya-ha-ha, you know how I feel right now? I feel like a prince who has overcome the obstacle of the Black Dragon Murakan to meet the princess."
Sandra was, quite literally, babbling nonstop.
There was no need to continue talking to someone who couldn't hold a proper conversation.
'If possible, subdue and capture alive.'
That was the conclusion. It was because they needed to learn about Sandra's abilities.
However, there was a reason for the premise "if possible."
Capturing Sandra meant exposing the Zipel's biological experiments once again to the world and potentially allowing other major forces to acquire and apply the results.
It was unlikely that the Zipel would be so careless.
'Until now, they've been poking holes in me since the days of the reserve knights, but they won't just let Sandra be captured.'

Either there were powerful reinforcements nearby, or there was a high probability that other means existed to prevent information leaks, like how Bement's mine completely oxidizes and disappears when it reaches its limit.
'No matter how fearless she is, she must have something to rely on to be so bold.'

Jin planned to use the Ice Sealing technique he learned from Valeria to preserve the 'evidence' that was Sandra Zipel. It might be difficult to go against the power of time, but there was no harm in trying.
Woo-woong!
Brahadamante resonated with aura and energy.
Sandra also hurriedly opened her magic to create a protective barrier. The flame-attribute barrier flared threateningly, but that was all.
In a single stroke, the barrier was split in two, and the attack magic that formed in Sandra's retreating hands couldn't inflict any damage on Jin.

On the other hand, Jin inflicted at least three serious injuries on Sandra before even ten seconds had passed. Including the first time her collarbone was pierced, Sandra had already been "killed" by Jin four times.
Sandra wasn't weak.
It's just that Jin had become incredibly strong. This was a fact that Vugo and the guardian knights, who had directly witnessed the 'Declaration of the Archduke,' had known all along.
Aside from the still-panicking group of Inhumans, the members of Bement and Zipl couldn't help but inwardly sigh as they watched the two fight.
With Murakan already overwhelming them, they now faced a future of annihilation, and the sudden confirmation of the 12th generation's power only made their prospects appear even bleaker.
But that wasn't all.
"Master!"
Two figures emerged from the shattered core of the Talgis.
It was the recently awakened Prochi siblings.
"Just give us the order, and Fei and I will slaughter them all."
The majestic Black Dragon flapping its wings and the Prochi siblings standing below it in the guise of ghosts were simply on a different level compared to the other factions.
Creek, creek, creek!
For some reason, Sandra's healing grew faster with each injury she sustained. However, she was unable to counterattack and focused solely on recovery.
Once her healing reached its maximum speed, Jin was no longer able to cut Sandra. Any wound he inflicted would heal before his blade even left her flesh.
It was a strange fight.
To an outsider, it might appear as if Jin was relentlessly tormenting a weaker opponent.
Jin continued to cut Sandra with an expressionless gaze.
There is no such thing as infinite power in the world.
Jin believed that and had always shattered the beliefs of those enemies who claimed to possess infinite power. This was true even for Amela, whose power had been amplified by the Talgis.
"Ha, at this rate, I'll really fall for you."
"What?"
It was the first time Jin paused and stopped his sword.
At this point, even Jin couldn't help but feel a chilling sensation down his spine.
'Humans can go this insane without even being corrupted by chaos.'
Jin responded with a smile.
"That's a horrible thing to say."
"Shall we get married? They say you're in marriage talks with the Grace of Bi Gung, but what about me?"
"If you tell me the secret of your super-regeneration, I'll consider it."
"Really? It's not that difficult of a condition. Have you heard of Masinseok? We were able to imitate some of the gods' powers with it......"
Boom!
Suddenly, an explosion occurred in the space between Jin and Sandra.
Jin managed to dodge it in an instant, but Sandra, unable to react in time, had half of her head blown away.
A spatial explosion.
The power of Kelliac Zipl, used by Midor Elna.
A murderous intent filled Jin's eyes as he turned his head.
"Sandra! What on earth are you talking about!"
"What the hell are you doing, you bastard! Can't you see that I'm communicating with Jin Lun Kandel? You were acting all well-educated earlier...!"
For Midor, it was a ridiculous situation that left him speechless. He never imagined that Sandra would mention the 'Masinseok.'
Jin was equally surprised.
'Judging from Midor's reaction, Masinseok is still a top-secret external power of Zipl. Of course, it has to be. It's clear that even the name itself must be kept extremely cautious.'
Furthermore, Sandra didn't just mention the name.
She also mentioned that they could 'imitate some of the gods' powers.' For Jin, this was an unexpected gain, but for Midor and Zipl, it was maddening.
"Interrupt me one more time, and I'll really kill you! Got it? I'll tear your limbs apart, chew them up, throw them away, and stomp on them! Answer me now, you bastard!"
It was a completely different malicious voice from the sweet nonsense she had been spouting to Jin just moments before. Even Murakan let out a hollow, sarcastic laugh at her fierce energy.
'Such a crazy person...! Left alone, there's no telling how far Sandra will go.'
What should he do?
As Midor made his decision, Bradamante traced a sharp trajectory.
"How could you do this to me, you bastard? You won't even ans...ugh!"
Squish!
Bradamante had cut off Sandra's right hand.
It was a moment of carelessness or a lapse in concentration.
Sandra had momentarily lost her maximum regenerative speed while pouring out her anger and hatred at Midor.
Jin wouldn't miss that opportunity. Unlike before, Sandra's wound didn't heal instantly. So, for the first time since the fight began, she experienced being severed.
To put it bluntly, her severed right arm fell to the ground.
Swoosh-!
Before her right arm hit the ground, Jin immediately formed a frost seal.
Jin could instantly see the healing state of Sandra's severed part. Unlike before, the cut surface didn't regenerate as if time was rewinding, but showed the same pattern as normal regeneration.
Now that he had evidence, there was no need to hesitate.
"Murakan!"
[Yes!]
"Sweep them all away!"
As Jin shouted, Murakan grinned with a sly smile.
